description:
Spec 097 FR-010 / ADR-034. Returns the tool registry generated from
openapi.yaml: one entry per operation with its version, status
(active / deprecated / retired), lens and schema hash, plus the
`registry_hash` over the whole set. Retired entries stay listed.
No database read: the registry is compiled into the running Worker.

Freshness: `observed_at` is the response time, `valid_until` is 24 hours
later, `stale_if_error` is 86400 seconds. `deployed_at` is the Worker
version timestamp, or null when the runtime does not expose it.
Add `?receipt=true` for a signed Receipt v1.0 over the same payload.

receipt.description: When true, attach a signed Receipt v1.0 committed to the transparency log. Additive — a signing failure never costs you the observation (ADR-014).

name: get_tool_registry
